card.name: Dates and years in disaster events
card.fires_on: Spaces and digits inside dates and years (day after month, middle digit of a year) in text about disasters such as fires, outbreaks or eruptions. Also a verb right after a storm.

modes.label: Date and year digits
modes.description: The space before a day number or a digit inside a year, in accounts of destructive events.
modes.example: The building was destroyed a fire after bombings on<< >>14 July 1943

modes.label: Storm damage verb
modes.description: A verb describing what a rainstorm did.
modes.example: a heavy overnight rainstorm had made the trail impassable and<< knocked>> down much of the giant web

card.writes: It pushes down fire-related words like fire and firefighter, and slightly favors storm words.
card.plain: It fires on date and year digits in stories of disasters and pushes the model away from saying fire words next.
